title: Text Extractor not working when Windows Magnifier is active
author: upyesp

status.label: Ready for focused reproduction
status.detail: The issue has deterministic steps and current source confirms the capture path is unaware of full-screen magnification.

next_action.label: S
next_action.reason: Reproduce on current Windows and design an unmagnified capture/coordinate path or a clear supported fallback.

judgment.rationale: The issue has deterministic steps and current source confirms the capture path is unaware of full-screen magnification.
evidence: Magnifier changes the selectable area to the visible zoomed viewport.
Text Extractor relies on screen-composited pixel copies.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce on current Windows and design an unmagnified capture/coordinate path or a clear supported fallback.

fix_assessment.rationale: No existing upstream fix attempt references this issue.

issue_context.summary: Text Extractor's overlay and capture coordinates break when Windows Magnifier is active in full-screen mode, preventing selection beyond the currently magnified viewport.
known_information: The report gives deterministic Magnifier and Text Extractor steps.
A second reporter confirms selection is limited to the visible zoomed portion.
Current Text Extractor captures pixels with Graphics.CopyFromScreen using overlay/screen rectangles.
inferences: The overlay operates in magnified desktop coordinates while CopyFromScreen captures the composed viewport, so pointer selection and source pixels no longer represent the full unmagnified desktop.
issue_context.analysis: This is a public, accessibility-critical reproduction. The current screen-copy implementation provides a concrete starting point for a maintainer-side test with Magnifier APIs/state; no new reporter logs are required to establish the first fix boundary.
initial_investigation: src/modules/PowerOCR/PowerOCR/Helpers/ImageMethods.cs uses CopyFromScreen for full-window, region, and clicked-word capture.
No Magnifier-aware coordinate or capture handling was found in the module.

actions.label: Design fix
actions.note: Start the bounded fork-side design workflow. This draft performs no upstream write.

actions.label: S
actions.note: Local maintainer verification only; no GitHub write is performed.

proposed_fixes.title: Make Text Extractor capture and selection Magnifier-aware
proposed_fixes.root_cause: CopyFromScreen and overlay coordinates observe the magnified composition rather than a stable unmagnified desktop coordinate space, so the selection cannot address off-viewport content.
plan: Detect active Windows Magnifier mode and capture its transform and viewport.
Map pointer/selection coordinates consistently to the source desktop or use a capture API that can obtain the unmagnified monitor surface.
Provide a safe fallback and accessibility messaging if Windows prevents full-desktop capture in a Magnifier mode.
verification: Run region and clicked-word extraction at multiple Magnifier zoom levels and modes, comparing selection geometry and OCR text with Magnifier off.

confidence.rationale: The capture implementation and viewport-limited symptom align, but Windows capture behavior must be measured to choose transform mapping versus another API.
